question.en: Can Immigrants Get Medicaid in North Carolina? (2026 Guide)
question.es: ¿Pueden los inmigrantes obtener Medicaid en Carolina del Norte? (Guía 2026)

shortAnswer.en: It depends on status: refugees qualify; DACA recipients do not.
shortAnswer.es: Depende del estatus: refugiados califican; beneficiarios de DACA no califican.

fullAnswer.en: It depends on your immigration status. North Carolina expanded Medicaid in December 2023, so income-eligible adults (up to 138% FPL, or $22,025/year for one person in 2026) can now qualify. Refugees, asylees, trafficking victims, and certain parolees from Afghanistan, Ukraine, Cuba, or Haiti qualify immediately with no five-year wait. Most other green card holders must wait five years. DACA recipients and undocumented immigrants cannot get full NC Medicaid but may access emergency Medicaid. Undocumented parents can apply for their children without disclosing their own status.
fullAnswer.es: Depende de su estatus migratorio. Carolina del Norte expandio Medicaid en diciembre de 2023, por lo que los adultos elegibles por ingresos (hasta el 138% del FPL, o $22,025 al ano para una persona en 2026) ahora pueden calificar. Los refugiados, asilados, victimas de trata y ciertos liberados bajo condicion de Afganistan, Ucrania, Cuba o Haiti califican de inmediato sin espera de cinco anos. La mayoria de los titulares de tarjeta verde deben esperar cinco anos. Los beneficiarios de DACA y los inmigrantes indocumentados no pueden obtener NC Medicaid completo pero pueden acceder a Medicaid de emergencia. Los padres indocumentados pueden solicitar cobertura para sus hijos sin revelar su propio estatus.

h1.en: Can Immigrants Get Medicaid in North Carolina? (2026)
h1.es: ¿Pueden los Inmigrantes Obtener Medicaid en Carolina del Norte? (2026)

introParagraphs.en: North Carolina expanded Medicaid in December 2023, opening NC Medicaid to hundreds of thousands of adults who previously did not qualify. For immigrants in North Carolina, whether you can get NC Medicaid in 2026 depends almost entirely on your immigration status, not just your income. Some categories qualify immediately. Others face a federal five-year waiting period. DACA recipients and undocumented immigrants are blocked from full coverage but retain access to emergency Medicaid.
introParagraphs.es: Carolina del Norte expandio Medicaid en diciembre de 2023, abriendo NC Medicaid a cientos de miles de adultos que antes no calificaban. Para los inmigrantes en Carolina del Norte, si pueden obtener NC Medicaid en 2026 depende casi en su totalidad de su estatus migratorio, no solo de sus ingresos. Algunas categorias califican de inmediato. Otras enfrentan un periodo de espera federal de cinco anos. Los beneficiarios de DACA y los inmigrantes indocumentados no pueden recibir cobertura completa pero conservan acceso a Medicaid de emergencia.

introParagraphs.en: This guide covers every immigration status category as recognized by NC Medicaid in 2026, the 2026 income limits for NC Medicaid by household size, how to apply through ePASS, what documents you will need, and what emergency Medicaid covers when full benefits are unavailable. Note that a federal reconciliation law enacted in 2025 will further restrict federal matching for some immigrant categories starting October 1, 2026. The income limits and household-size table below apply to adults who pass the immigration status test.
introParagraphs.es: Esta guia cubre cada categoria de estatus migratorio reconocida por NC Medicaid en 2026, los limites de ingresos de NC Medicaid por tamano del hogar en 2026, como solicitar a traves de ePASS, que documentos necesitara, y que cubre Medicaid de emergencia cuando los beneficios completos no estan disponibles. Tenga en cuenta que una ley de reconciliacion federal promulgada en 2025 restringira aun mas el financiamiento federal para algunas categorias de inmigrantes a partir del 1 de octubre de 2026.

numberedSteps.en: Step 1: Gather documents before you start. You will need proof of identity, proof of North Carolina residency, proof of income, your immigration documents (green card, I-94, visa, EAD card, asylum letter, refugee document, or DACA approval), and Social Security numbers for any household member who has one.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 1: Reuna sus documentos antes de comenzar. Necesitara prueba de identidad, prueba de residencia en Carolina del Norte, prueba de ingresos, sus documentos de inmigracion (tarjeta verde, I-94, visa, tarjeta EAD, carta de asilo, documento de refugiado o aprobacion de DACA) y numeros de Seguro Social para cualquier miembro del hogar que lo tenga.

numberedSteps.en: Step 2: Apply online through ePASS at epass.nc.gov. Create a free NCID account if you do not have one. Select 'Medical Assistance' on the benefits menu. The application takes 30 to 45 minutes and is available in English and Spanish.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 2: Solicite en linea a traves de ePASS en epass.nc.gov. Cree una cuenta NCID gratuita si no tiene una. Seleccione 'Asistencia Medica' en el menu de beneficios. La solicitud tarda de 30 a 45 minutos y esta disponible en ingles y espanol.

numberedSteps.en: Step 3: You may also apply in person at your county Department of Social Services (DSS) office in North Carolina, or by calling NC Medicaid at 1-888-245-0179 (TTY: 711). Bring all your documents.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 3: Tambien puede solicitar en persona en la oficina del Departamento de Servicios Sociales (DSS) de su condado en Carolina del Norte, o llamando a NC Medicaid al 1-888-245-0179 (TTY: 711). Lleve todos sus documentos.

numberedSteps.en: Step 4: NC DHHS has up to 45 days to process your NC Medicaid application. For pregnant applicants, processing is expedited. Upload any requested verification documents promptly through ePASS to avoid delays.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 4: NC DHHS tiene hasta 45 dias para procesar su solicitud de NC Medicaid. Para solicitantes embarazadas, el procesamiento es mas rapido. Cargue oportunamente cualquier documento de verificacion solicitado a traves de ePASS para evitar demoras.

numberedSteps.en: Step 5: If approved, enroll in a North Carolina Medicaid managed care plan. Most NC Medicaid enrollees are assigned to a Standard Plan, which is a private health plan under contract with NC DHHS. You will receive a card and plan information by mail.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 5: Si es aprobado, inscribase en un plan de atencion administrada de NC Medicaid. La mayoria de los inscritos en NC Medicaid son asignados a un Plan Estandar, que es un plan de salud privado bajo contrato con NC DHHS. Recibira una tarjeta e informacion del plan por correo.

heading.en: Direct Answer: Which Immigrants Qualify for NC Medicaid in 2026?
heading.es: Respuesta directa: que inmigrantes califican para NC Medicaid en 2026?

paragraphs.en: It depends on immigration status. NC Medicaid follows federal rules dividing non-citizens into qualified aliens (full coverage) and others who cannot qualify. Refugees and asylees qualify immediately. Most green card holders face a five-year bar. DACA recipients and undocumented immigrants cannot get full NC Medicaid but may access emergency Medicaid. Adults who pass the immigration test must also earn at or below 138% FPL ($22,025/year for one person in 2026).
paragraphs.es: Depende del estatus migratorio. NC Medicaid sigue las reglas federales que dividen a los no ciudadanos en extranjeros calificados (cobertura completa) y otros que no califican. Los refugiados y asilados califican de inmediato. La mayoria de los titulares de tarjeta verde enfrentan una barrera de cinco anos. Los beneficiarios de DACA y los inmigrantes indocumentados no pueden obtener NC Medicaid completo pero pueden acceder a Medicaid de emergencia. Los adultos que pasan la prueba de inmigracion tambien deben ganar igual o por debajo del 138% del FPL ($22,025/ano para una persona en 2026).

heading.en: Immigration Status Categories and NC Medicaid Eligibility
heading.es: Categorias de estatus migratorio y elegibilidad para NC Medicaid

paragraphs.en: North Carolina follows federal rules under the Personal Responsibility and Work Opportunity Reconciliation Act of 1996 (PRWORA). Federal law divides non-citizens into two groups: qualified aliens who may access Medicaid subject to income tests and, in some cases, a five-year waiting period; and non-qualified aliens who cannot access full Medicaid. Below is how North Carolina applies these categories in 2026.
paragraphs.es: Carolina del Norte sigue las reglas federales bajo la Ley de Responsabilidad Personal y Reconciliacion de Oportunidades de Trabajo de 1996 (PRWORA). La ley federal divide a los no ciudadanos en dos grupos: extranjeros calificados que pueden acceder a Medicaid sujeto a pruebas de ingresos y, en algunos casos, un periodo de espera de cinco anos; y extranjeros no calificados que no pueden acceder a Medicaid completo.

heading.en: NC Medicaid Income Limits by Household Size 2026
heading.es: Limites de ingresos de NC Medicaid por tamano del hogar 2026

paragraphs.en: North Carolina Medicaid uses Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) to count income. For expansion adults ages 19 to 64 who also meet the immigration status requirement, the North Carolina income limit is 138% of the Federal Poverty Level. In 2026, that equals $22,025 per year ($1,835 per month) for a single person, or $45,540 per year ($3,795 per month) for a family of four. The household-size table above shows limits for households 1 through 8 and the per-person increment for larger households.
paragraphs.es: NC Medicaid usa el Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI) para contar ingresos. Para los adultos de expansion de 19 a 64 anos que tambien cumplen el requisito de estatus migratorio, el limite de ingresos de Carolina del Norte es el 138% del Nivel de Pobreza Federal. En 2026, eso equivale a $22,025 por ano ($1,835 por mes) para una persona sola, o $45,540 por ano ($3,795 por mes) para una familia de cuatro.

paragraphs.en: North Carolina is an expansion state, so there is no coverage gap for income-eligible adults between 100% and 138% FPL. If your income falls below the threshold, you are directed to NC Medicaid. If your income is between 100% and 400% FPL and you do not qualify for NC Medicaid based on immigration status, you may be able to purchase coverage through the federal marketplace at healthcare.gov, though federal subsidies are generally not available to immigrants without lawful permanent status or certain qualifying statuses.
paragraphs.es: Carolina del Norte es un estado de expansion, por lo que no hay brecha de cobertura para adultos elegibles por ingresos entre el 100% y el 138% del FPL. Si sus ingresos caen por debajo del umbral, se le dirige a NC Medicaid. Si sus ingresos estan entre el 100% y el 400% del FPL y no califica para NC Medicaid por estatus migratorio, puede comprar cobertura a traves del mercado federal en healthcare.gov.

heading.en: The Five-Year Bar: How It Works for NC Medicaid
heading.es: La barrera de cinco anos: como funciona para NC Medicaid

paragraphs.en: Federal law enacted in 1996 under PRWORA requires most qualified aliens to wait five years before they can access full Medicaid. For green card holders (Lawful Permanent Residents) in North Carolina, the five-year clock starts on the date you received your LPR status, not the date you first arrived in the United States. If you received your green card in 2022, you would become eligible in 2027. If you received it in 2021 or earlier, you may already be past the bar.
paragraphs.es: La ley federal promulgada en 1996 bajo PRWORA requiere que la mayoria de los extranjeros calificados esperen cinco anos antes de poder acceder a Medicaid completo. Para los titulares de tarjeta verde (Residentes Permanentes Legales) en Carolina del Norte, el conteo de cinco anos comienza en la fecha en que recibio su estatus LPR, no en la fecha en que llego por primera vez a los Estados Unidos.

paragraphs.en: Several categories are exempt from the five-year bar in North Carolina. Refugees and asylees granted status by USCIS qualify immediately with no waiting period. Trafficking victims with T visas or HHS certification, Cuban-Haitian entrants, humanitarian parolees from Afghanistan, Ukraine, Cuba, or Haiti (for paroles of one year or more), and certain veterans and active military qualify immediately. If you are unsure whether your status is bar-exempt, contact NC Medicaid at 1-888-245-0179 or a legal aid organization such as Legal Aid of North Carolina.
paragraphs.es: Varias categorias estan exentas de la barrera de cinco anos en Carolina del Norte. Los refugiados y asilados con estatus otorgado por USCIS califican de inmediato sin periodo de espera. Las victimas de trata con visas T o certificacion del HHS, los ingresantes cubano-haitianos, los liberados bajo condicion humanitaria de Afganistan, Ucrania, Cuba o Haiti, y ciertos veteranos y militares activos califican de inmediato.

heading.en: Children and Pregnant Individuals: Special NC Medicaid Rules
heading.es: Ninos y personas embarazadas: reglas especiales de NC Medicaid

paragraphs.en: North Carolina has adopted the federal ICHIA (Immigrant Children's Health Improvement Act) option for children and pregnant individuals. Under this option, children under age 19 with any lawful immigration status, except DACA, qualify for NC Medicaid regardless of how long they have been in the country and regardless of whether their parents are eligible. Undocumented parents can apply for their lawfully present children without disclosing their own immigration status.
paragraphs.es: Carolina del Norte ha adoptado la opcion federal ICHIA (Ley de Mejora de la Salud de los Ninos Inmigrantes) para ninos y personas embarazadas. Bajo esta opcion, los ninos menores de 19 anos con cualquier estatus migratorio legal, excepto DACA, califican para NC Medicaid independientemente de cuanto tiempo lleven en el pais y de si sus padres son elegibles. Los padres indocumentados pueden solicitar para sus hijos legalmente presentes sin revelar su propio estatus migratorio.

paragraphs.en: Pregnant individuals in North Carolina with any lawful immigration status, except DACA, also qualify for NC Medicaid immediately without the five-year wait. The income limit for pregnant individuals is up to 196% FPL, which is higher than the standard adult expansion limit of 138% FPL. Pregnancy Medicaid in North Carolina covers prenatal care, labor and delivery, and 60 days of postpartum care. DACA-status pregnant individuals do not qualify for full pregnancy Medicaid but may qualify for emergency Medicaid covering labor and delivery.
paragraphs.es: Las personas embarazadas en Carolina del Norte con cualquier estatus migratorio legal, excepto DACA, tambien califican para NC Medicaid de inmediato sin la espera de cinco anos. El limite de ingresos para personas embarazadas es hasta el 196% del FPL, mas alto que el limite estandar de expansion adulta del 138% del FPL. NC Medicaid de embarazo cubre atencion prenatal, parto y 60 dias de atencion posparto.

heading.en: Emergency Medicaid in North Carolina: What It Covers
heading.es: Medicaid de emergencia en Carolina del Norte: que cubre

paragraphs.en: North Carolina provides emergency Medicaid to any resident who meets income requirements, regardless of immigration status. Emergency Medicaid is limited to treatment of emergency medical conditions, meaning conditions where the absence of immediate medical attention could result in serious jeopardy to health, serious impairment of a bodily function, or serious dysfunction of a body organ. This includes emergency room visits, inpatient hospital stabilization, active labor and delivery, and surgery to stabilize an emergency.
paragraphs.es: Carolina del Norte proporciona Medicaid de emergencia a cualquier residente que cumpla los requisitos de ingresos, independientemente del estatus migratorio. Medicaid de emergencia se limita al tratamiento de condiciones medicas de emergencia, es decir, condiciones en las que la ausencia de atencion medica inmediata podria resultar en un serio peligro para la salud, deterioro grave de una funcion corporal o disfuncion grave de un organo.

paragraphs.en: Emergency Medicaid does not cover routine care, primary care, mental health services, prescription drugs for ongoing conditions, or planned procedures. It is not a substitute for full Medicaid coverage. For ongoing care needs, immigrants who do not qualify for NC Medicaid should contact Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs) in North Carolina, which provide sliding-scale care regardless of immigration status, or NC Navigator organizations that provide free enrollment assistance.
paragraphs.es: Medicaid de emergencia no cubre atencion de rutina, atencion primaria, servicios de salud mental, medicamentos recetados para condiciones continuas o procedimientos planificados. No es un sustituto de la cobertura completa de Medicaid. Para necesidades de atencion continua, los inmigrantes que no califican para NC Medicaid deben contactar Centros de Salud Calificados Federalmente (FQHC) en Carolina del Norte.

heading.en: DACA Recipients in North Carolina: Your 2026 Options
heading.es: Beneficiarios de DACA en Carolina del Norte: sus opciones en 2026

paragraphs.en: DACA (Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals) recipients in North Carolina are not considered qualified aliens under federal Medicaid law and therefore cannot access full NC Medicaid. This has been the rule since DACA was created in 2012 and remains unchanged in 2026. DACA recipients may qualify for emergency Medicaid in North Carolina if they meet income requirements and face a true emergency.
paragraphs.es: Los beneficiarios de DACA (Accion Diferida para los Llegados en la Infancia) en Carolina del Norte no son considerados extranjeros calificados bajo la ley federal de Medicaid y por lo tanto no pueden acceder a NC Medicaid completo. Esta ha sido la regla desde que DACA fue creado en 2012 y permanece sin cambios en 2026.

paragraphs.en: North Carolina does not use state-funded Medicaid to extend coverage to DACA recipients beyond what federal law requires. DACA recipients in North Carolina may purchase a plan through the federal Marketplace at healthcare.gov, though they are not eligible for premium tax credits (PTCs) under current federal law. Federally Qualified Health Centers in North Carolina serve patients regardless of immigration status on a sliding-fee scale. NC Legal Aid at 1-866-219-5262 can advise on available options.
paragraphs.es: Carolina del Norte no usa fondos estatales de Medicaid para extender cobertura a los beneficiarios de DACA mas alla de lo que requiere la ley federal. Los beneficiarios de DACA en Carolina del Norte pueden comprar un plan a traves del Mercado federal en healthcare.gov, aunque no son elegibles para creditos fiscales de prima (PTC) bajo la ley federal actual.

heading.en: Is North Carolina a Medicaid Expansion State?
heading.es: Es Carolina del Norte un estado de expansion de Medicaid?

paragraphs.en: Yes. North Carolina expanded Medicaid under the Affordable Care Act effective December 1, 2023. Before expansion, adults without children had no path to Medicaid regardless of income. Now, adults ages 19 to 64 with incomes up to 138% FPL can qualify for NC Medicaid. Expansion has enrolled more than 600,000 North Carolinians. For immigrants, expansion matters because it broadened who counts as income-eligible, but the immigration status test still applies separately.
paragraphs.es: Si. Carolina del Norte expandio Medicaid bajo la Ley de Cuidado de Salud Asequible con vigencia desde el 1 de diciembre de 2023. Antes de la expansion, los adultos sin hijos no tenian acceso a Medicaid independientemente de sus ingresos. Ahora, los adultos de 19 a 64 anos con ingresos hasta el 138% del FPL pueden calificar para NC Medicaid. La expansion ha inscrito a mas de 600,000 habitantes de Carolina del Norte.

paragraphs.en: North Carolina's Medicaid program is administered by the NC Department of Health and Human Services (NCDHHS), Division of Medical Assistance. Most enrollees are served through a managed care model under Standard Plans operated by commercial health plans under contract with NCDHHS. The program covers primary care, specialist visits, hospitalization, mental health, dental for children, prescription drugs, and preventive services.
paragraphs.es: El programa Medicaid de Carolina del Norte es administrado por el Departamento de Salud y Servicios Humanos de Carolina del Norte (NCDHHS), Division de Asistencia Medica. La mayoria de los inscritos son atendidos a traves de un modelo de atencion administrada bajo Planes Estandar operados por planes de salud comerciales bajo contrato con NCDHHS.

heading.en: Common Reasons NC Medicaid Applications Are Denied for Immigrants
heading.es: Razones comunes por las que se deniegan solicitudes de NC Medicaid para inmigrantes

paragraphs.en: NC Medicaid denials for immigrant applicants cluster around five issues. First, the immigration status is not in an eligible category: DACA, TPS holders in most cases, and undocumented individuals will be denied full coverage. Second, the five-year bar has not been met: a green card holder who obtained LPR status less than five years ago will be denied until the bar is cleared. Third, the income is above 138% FPL for the household size in 2026. Fourth, documents are missing or the state cannot verify the immigration status through the SAVE system (the federal database used to confirm lawful presence). Fifth, North Carolina residency cannot be confirmed.
paragraphs.es: Las denegaciones de NC Medicaid para solicitantes inmigrantes se concentran en cinco problemas. Primero, el estatus migratorio no esta en una categoria elegible. Segundo, la barrera de cinco anos no se ha cumplido. Tercero, los ingresos estan por encima del 138% del FPL. Cuarto, faltan documentos o el estado no puede verificar el estatus migratorio a traves del sistema SAVE. Quinto, no se puede confirmar la residencia en Carolina del Norte.

paragraphs.en: If your application is denied, North Carolina Medicaid must send a written notice explaining the reason. You have 90 days from the date on the notice to request a fair hearing through NCDHHS. During the appeal, you may request continued benefits if you were already enrolled and a redetermination caused the denial. Contact Legal Aid of North Carolina at 1-866-219-5262 or NC Justice Center for free help appealing a denial.
paragraphs.es: Si su solicitud es denegada, NC Medicaid debe enviarle un aviso por escrito explicando la razon. Tiene 90 dias a partir de la fecha del aviso para solicitar una audiencia justa a traves de NCDHHS. Durante la apelacion, puede solicitar beneficios continuados si ya estaba inscrito y una nueva determinacion causo la denegacion.

en.question: Can undocumented immigrants get NC Medicaid?
en.answer: No, not full NC Medicaid. Undocumented immigrants are not qualified aliens under federal law and cannot access full NC Medicaid coverage. However, they can receive emergency Medicaid in North Carolina for true medical emergencies such as an ER visit, active labor and delivery, or surgery to stabilize a condition. Undocumented parents can apply for their lawfully present children without disclosing their own immigration status.

en.question: Do green card holders qualify for NC Medicaid?
en.answer: Yes, after a five-year waiting period. Most Lawful Permanent Residents (green card holders) must wait five years from the date they obtained LPR status before qualifying for full NC Medicaid. If you have held a green card for five or more years and your income is at or below 138% FPL ($22,025 per year for one person in 2026), you qualify for NC Medicaid. Several exemptions apply: refugees, asylees, and veterans bypass the five-year bar entirely.

en.question: Can DACA recipients get Medicaid in North Carolina?
en.answer: No, not full Medicaid. DACA is not a qualifying immigration status under federal Medicaid law. DACA recipients in North Carolina can only access emergency Medicaid for true emergencies. North Carolina does not use state-only funds to extend coverage beyond what federal law requires. DACA recipients may purchase marketplace plans at healthcare.gov but are not eligible for premium tax credits under current law.

en.question: Can refugees get NC Medicaid?
en.answer: Yes, immediately. Refugees in North Carolina are exempt from the five-year bar and qualify for full NC Medicaid as soon as they meet the income test (138% FPL for adults, or $22,025 per year for one person in 2026). Asylees, trafficking victims with T visas, Cuban-Haitian entrants, and humanitarian parolees from Afghanistan, Ukraine, Cuba, or Haiti also qualify immediately with no waiting period.

en.question: Can my child get NC Medicaid even if I am undocumented?
en.answer: Yes. Children under 19 with any lawful immigration status, except DACA, qualify for NC Medicaid under the ICHIA option. Undocumented parents can apply for their lawfully present children without providing their own immigration status. The income limit for children ages 1 to 18 is up to 216% FPL, which is higher than the adult expansion limit of 138% FPL in 2026.

en.question: What is the income limit for a family of 4 on NC Medicaid in 2026?
en.answer: For expansion adults ages 19 to 64, the 2026 NC Medicaid income limit for a family of four is $45,540 per year ($3,795 per month), which equals 138% of the 2026 Federal Poverty Level. Children in the same household can qualify at up to 216% FPL. These figures are based on 2026 ASPE poverty guidelines and NCDHHS income limit tables.

en.question: How do I apply for NC Medicaid as an immigrant?
en.answer: Apply online through ePASS at epass.nc.gov, in person at your county DSS office, or by phone at 1-888-245-0179. You will need your immigration documents (green card, I-94, asylum letter, refugee document, or other USCIS-issued document), proof of North Carolina residency, and proof of income. NC DHHS has 45 days to process your application. Applications are accepted year-round.

en.question: What does emergency Medicaid cover in North Carolina?
en.answer: Emergency Medicaid in North Carolina covers only the treatment of true emergency medical conditions, meaning conditions that would cause serious harm if not treated immediately. Covered services include emergency room visits, inpatient hospital stabilization, active labor and delivery, and emergency surgery. It does not cover routine care, primary care, prescription drugs for ongoing conditions, mental health services, or planned procedures.

es.question: Can los inmigrantes indocumentados obtener NC Medicaid?
es.answer: No, no el NC Medicaid completo. Los inmigrantes indocumentados no son extranjeros calificados bajo la ley federal y no pueden acceder a la cobertura completa de NC Medicaid. Sin embargo, pueden recibir Medicaid de emergencia en Carolina del Norte para emergencias medicas reales como visitas a urgencias, parto activo o cirugia para estabilizar una condicion. Los padres indocumentados pueden solicitar para sus hijos legalmente presentes sin revelar su propio estatus migratorio.

es.question: Los titulares de tarjeta verde califican para NC Medicaid?
es.answer: Si, despues de un periodo de espera de cinco anos. La mayoria de los Residentes Permanentes Legales (titulares de tarjeta verde) deben esperar cinco anos desde la fecha en que obtuvieron el estatus LPR antes de calificar para NC Medicaid completo. Si ha tenido una tarjeta verde durante cinco o mas anos y sus ingresos son iguales o inferiores al 138% del FPL ($22,025 por ano para una persona en 2026), califica para NC Medicaid.

es.question: Los beneficiarios de DACA pueden obtener Medicaid en Carolina del Norte?
es.answer: No, no el Medicaid completo. DACA no es un estatus migratorio calificador bajo la ley federal de Medicaid. Los beneficiarios de DACA en Carolina del Norte solo pueden acceder a Medicaid de emergencia para verdaderas emergencias. Carolina del Norte no usa fondos solo estatales para extender cobertura mas alla de lo que requiere la ley federal.

es.question: Los refugiados pueden obtener NC Medicaid?
es.answer: Si, de inmediato. Los refugiados en Carolina del Norte estan exentos de la barrera de cinco anos y califican para NC Medicaid completo tan pronto como cumplan la prueba de ingresos (138% del FPL para adultos, o $22,025 por ano para una persona en 2026). Los asilados, victimas de trata con visas T, ingresantes cubano-haitianos y liberados bajo condicion humanitaria de Afganistan, Ucrania, Cuba o Haiti tambien califican de inmediato.

es.question: Mi hijo puede obtener NC Medicaid aunque yo sea indocumentado?
es.answer: Si. Los ninos menores de 19 anos con cualquier estatus migratorio legal, excepto DACA, califican para NC Medicaid bajo la opcion ICHIA. Los padres indocumentados pueden solicitar para sus hijos legalmente presentes sin proporcionar su propio estatus migratorio. El limite de ingresos para ninos de 1 a 18 anos es hasta el 216% del FPL, mas alto que el limite de expansion adulta del 138% del FPL en 2026.

es.question: Cual es el limite de ingresos para una familia de 4 en NC Medicaid en 2026?
es.answer: Para adultos de expansion de 19 a 64 anos, el limite de ingresos de NC Medicaid 2026 para una familia de cuatro es $45,540 por ano ($3,795 por mes), que equivale al 138% del Nivel de Pobreza Federal 2026. Los ninos en el mismo hogar pueden calificar hasta el 216% del FPL.

es.question: Como solicito NC Medicaid como inmigrante?
es.answer: Solicite en linea a traves de ePASS en epass.nc.gov, en persona en la oficina DSS de su condado, o por telefono al 1-888-245-0179. Necesitara sus documentos de inmigracion, prueba de residencia en Carolina del Norte y prueba de ingresos. NC DHHS tiene 45 dias para procesar su solicitud. Las solicitudes se aceptan todo el ano.

es.question: Que cubre Medicaid de emergencia en Carolina del Norte?
es.answer: Medicaid de emergencia en Carolina del Norte cubre solo el tratamiento de verdaderas condiciones medicas de emergencia. Los servicios cubiertos incluyen visitas a urgencias, estabilizacion hospitalaria, parto activo y cirugia de emergencia. No cubre atencion de rutina, atencion primaria, medicamentos recetados para condiciones continuas, servicios de salud mental o procedimientos planificados.
